action.description: The command's action. A capability_denied reply (status rejected) echoes the refused command's action, which can be deploy or remove as well as execute, connect_and_ping or shell.

http_status.description: HTTP status code for REST routes

has_more.description: Keyset pagination: true when more rows exist beyond this page. Present only on keyset list reads.

last_keyset_value.description: Keyset pagination: the keyset_field value of the last returned row; the dispatcher encodes it as the next cursor. Present only when has_more is true.

events_emitted.description: write_with_events only: how many change events were inserted in the same transaction as the record write. Present only on success.
